title: ONI Companion Link: companion/art/manifest.json (v1.2)
description: Written by the mod, with write-tmp-then-rename, after the PNGs it lists exist. Files live at companion/art/<path>. Art is rendered from the running game on the user's device; none ships in the repo or the app. v1.2: ON DEMAND (`onDemand` true): there is no catalog run; catalog files are drawn when the core sends an `art_request` command and are kept per game build; the manifest is rewritten at most once a second while images are being drawn (at once for a portrait). Duplicant portraits are drawn for the loaded colony right after the world loads and again when appearanceHash changes (at most one per second). The core serves them as GET /api/v1/art/<kind>/<id> and 404s anything not listed or whose file is missing.

catalogComplete.description: Mod 0.2.1 and older only (a catalog run). Not written from 0.2.2.

stats.description: Mod 0.2.1 and older only. Not written from 0.2.2 (frame times go to Player.log).

onDemand.description: True when the mod draws catalog art only on request (`art_request`). The core adds art URLs for items without an image yet only when this is true.

renderRev.description: Revision of how images are drawn; images of another revision are drawn again. Absent = 1.

ArtKind.description: building, element, critter, plant, seed, egg, food, medicine, item (other resources) = catalog, 128 px. dupe = duplicant portrait, 256 px. ui = theme 9-slice images (listed in the theme, not here).

id.description: The game's id (prefab, element or tag id); for dupe, live.json duplicants[].id.

appearanceHash.description: dupe only: the live.json hash this portrait shows. The core serves the entry whose hash matches the dupe's current hash, else the newest.

srcKey.description: Catalog images: a stable fingerprint (FNV-1a 64) of the game asset the image was drawn from (kind, sprite name, atlas texture name and size, sprite rectangle, tint), computed without drawing. Equal key = same art in the game. Optional; absent on older images.
